status: proposed supplement for root review; implements the unapproved proposal P-V2-10; not approved
problem: The 0.19 cases express part of the server behaviour as templates ('gen' log generator, 'repeat' data) and the rest as the MockLogServer's default handler. A TypeScript or Node harness would have to re-implement both to reproduce the replies.

perRun.id: case id, or '<case>@<fault>' for the nine fault controls
perRun.fault: null or the client fault of the control

requests.t: client clock in ms when sent

form.replayRule: A conforming harness serves request k with requests[k-1].reply if and only if the request and its time equal requests[k-1].req and .t; any other request is a test failure (the reference replay answers -32603 literalReplayMismatch and records it).

whyGenerated: The transcripts are produced by the accepted 0.19 reference MockLogServer from the reviewed 0.19 fixtures, not typed by hand: the replies of 45 cases and 9 controls, carrying 64-hex hashes, cannot be hand-copied reliably. They become fixtures only after root has re-run the generator and verified the replay checks below.

checks.text: For every case, the recording wrapper changes nothing: requests, sink events and result equal run_checks_019.run_case.

Each case run against the literal server only (after a JSON text round trip of the transcript) gives zero mismatches, consumes exactly the transcript, and reproduces every fixture cell of lc-cases.json (requests, events, result, steps).
Each fault control replays to the same outcome as its generator run.
Two exports from two independent generator runs are byte-identical; its SHA-256 is recorded.

preserved: lc-cases.json and its templates are unchanged; the templates remain the 0.19 authoring form.
